text:
hana: dropping a new slim-rows mock for the model catalog compare view. Goal: single-line rows, subtle discovery for metrics + perf badges, and clearer version pin affordance. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/slim-rows-compare
oliver: clean! I like the idea of a micro-affordance instead of full persistent badges. How about a 6px indicator + chevron that becomes a 44px focus target on keyboard nav? Keeps scanning density low.
tess: accessibility flags: small indicators need a focusable element and high contrast; 6px alone won't cut it. We should provide an explicit focus ring and SR text. Proposed aria: aria-controls="variant-panel-<id>" and aria-expanded toggled on open.
sam: pinning UX question: if a user pins a version in the compare table, should it persist per-project or per-user? Expectation differs. My preference: per-user pin (sticky in their session) with an optional team-level pin for shared dashboards.
hana: good call. I'll spec per-user sticky pin and a separate 'Make default for team' action that requires team perms. Will sketch microcopy for that.
oliver: perf note: when reveal happens, avoid reflow. Use opacity+translateY on the badge container and keep layout stable. Also defer chart/tooltip mount until panel open.
ux-bot: Accessibility checklist reminder: focusable affordance size >= 44px, contrast >= 4.5:1 for small text, visible focus indicator, aria-live for dynamic updates. See: https://intranet.redwood.ai/a11y/checklist
tess: CSS snippet suggestion:
```css
.affordance { width:44px; height:44px; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; }
.badge { transform: translateY(4px); opacity:0; transition: transform .12s ease, opacity .12s ease; }
.row:focus-within .badge, .row:hover .badge { transform: translateY(0); opacity:1; }
```
oliver: microcopy choices for the affordance tooltip: 'View metrics', 'Open metrics', 'Inspect version'. I vote 'View metrics' — succinct and action-oriented.
sam: +1 'View metrics'. For the pin CTA: 'Pin version' and for team default: 'Pin as team default'. Add confirmation toast: 'Pinned version saved to your view.'
tess: contrast nit: the performance badge color in the mock (#7B8794) is borderline at small size. Suggest #1F2937 for text or a faint 1px stroke. Also include a visible state for reduced contrast modes.
hana: note for engineering: include prefers-reduced-motion support (instant reveal) and ensure table virtualization for catalogs > 300 rows so focus doesn't skip.
DeployBot: Preview deployed to staging: https://staging.redwood.ai/preview/slim-rows-2360012345
hana: action items: update figma with 44px affordance, add aria attributes & SR strings, change microcopy to 'View metrics', spec per-user pin + team default flow, update badge contrast tokens, add reduced-motion and virtualization notes. Will post updated link + PR once done. Thanks! :tada:
